text.tspan: From Generated Human Motions to Humanoid Vision-Language-Action Policies
Kevin Park¹* Izat Rasyad²* Dvij Kalaria² Shankar Sastry²
¹ Princeton University ² University of California, Berkeley * Equal contribution
Generated motion → residual expert → corrective recovery → vision-language-action policy
Replace repeated task-specific teleoperation with generated motion
Task text + contact constraints → OmniControl human motion →
OmniRetarget G1 references. Augment with HumanoidMimicGen.
SONIC supplies a whole-body motion prior. A privileged residual expert
co-tracks the robot and task object under randomized physics.
Record egocentric RGB, proprioception, executed tokens, hand
commands, and language in LeRobot format. Initialize GR00T on
Executed token = SONIC token + learned residual
Offline demonstrations cover expert states. Learner errors alter
contacts and move the VLA away from that distribution.
Execute images + proprioception + language. Save simulator states
Sample a time uniformly from the failed rollout. Restore that state and
The privileged expert attempts recovery. Keep the corrective trajectory
only when it completes the task.
Add successful reference-conditioned continuations, build action
chunks within each segment, and repeat for three DAgger rounds.
RGB + robot state + instruction → token / hand actions → frozen SONIC
decoder. No privileged object state or reference input.
Matched final frames from the paper: nominal tracking loses the bottle;
100 random environment settings per task; paper Table 2.
Corrective data vs. more offline data
200 initial + 200 successful corrections per round = 800 total trajectories. Offline control: 800
With 800 trajectories, DAgger reaches 54% pick, 60% drawer, 69%
Scope: simulation only; pretrained motion, control, and VLA backbones remain in use.
Built on DreamControl / OmniControl · OmniRetarget · HumanoidMimicGen · SONIC · GR00T. DAgger: Ross et al., AISTATS 2011.
